name: web-generative-sequencer
description: Generative Euclidean sequencer driving a modal string voice, built on the Web Audio API.

scripts.//typecheck: Editors read jsconfig.json with no install. This is for a CLI or CI gate, and needs `npm i -D typescript` first.
scripts.//lint: Needs `npm i -D eslint@9` first -- same ad-hoc pattern as typecheck.
scripts.//test:browser: Needs `npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium` first. Runs the 9 test/browser/*-check.html pages headlessly -- see scripts/check-browser-pages.mjs.
